current_plate.title: In India. Snows of the Himalayas
current_plate.verdict: Compliant. A colour oil painting of a Himalayan snow massif; illustration, region-accurate. Not a rule violation. Options requested only to compare a more iconic/recognisable vista.

nepal_note: The current plate and the range-vista candidates below are eastern-Himalaya (Sikkim/Darjeeling), not Nepal-specific. The Oldfield Kathmandu watercolour is the one genuinely Nepal (Kathmandu Valley) option found; it is a temple-square cityscape rather than a mountain skyline.

candidates.title: The Kumari Jatra: three temple cars outside the Hanuman Dhoka (Old Palace), Kathmandu
candidates.fit: Vivid colour watercolour of Kathmandu Durbar Square with its pagoda temples during the Kumari Jatra festival; the only genuinely NEPAL-specific illustrated view found. A temple-square cityscape rather than a mountain vista.

candidates.title: Kangchenjunga from Darjeeling
candidates.collection: Google Art Project, via Wikimedia Commons
candidates.fit: Luminous colour oil of the actual Kangchenjunga snow massif above a Darjeeling forest ridge; a definitive eastern-Himalaya vista and the strongest recognisable range view.

candidates.title: Himalayas, Sikkim
candidates.licence: Public domain in 70-yr-pma countries (artist d. 1947). Check jurisdiction before use.
candidates.fit: Wide, atmospheric Sikkim Himalaya snow peak; panoramic and hero-croppable, unmistakably the high range. Licence caveat: Roerich PD only in life+70 countries.

candidates.title: Kangchenjunga
candidates.licence: Public domain in 70-yr-pma countries (artist d. 1947). Check jurisdiction before use.
candidates.fit: Roerich's iconic tempera of pink-lit Kangchenjunga peaks over blue foothills; instantly reads as the high Himalaya. Lower resolution (1024px) and same licence caveat.

candidates.title: Crossing the river Touse by rope bridge, Himalaya mountains
candidates.artist: Aquatint in the manner of James Baillie Fraser
candidates.border_or_mount_to_trim: yes (paper margin and title line at foot)
candidates.fit: Period hand-coloured travel aquatint of a Himalayan river gorge and forested ranges; classic topographical print, though a gorge scene rather than a snow-peak skyline.

recommendation: For a mountain vista: himalayas/lear-kangchenjunga-darjeeling.jpg (Edward Lear, Kangchenjunga from Darjeeling) - clean, colour, unambiguous high-Himalaya, no licence caveat. For a genuinely Nepal-specific pick: himalayas/oldfield-kathmandu-durbar.jpg (colour Kathmandu Durbar Square, CC0). Roerich 'Himalayas, Sikkim' is the boldest panorama if the life+70 licence is acceptable.
